notes.title: VoiceBot 3.9.6 Now Available!
notes.content:
We're very excited to announce that VoiceBot 3.9.6 is now available for download! This new version cleans up some minor issues.

VoiceBot 3.9.6 Changes

Note: This is the last version of VoiceBot that will install and run on Windows 7/8
Change: Added the "Actions" column to the left pane in the main window
Change: VoiceBot no longer pauses while the Settings window is open
Change: VoiceBot scripted macros can now use DisplayFusion scripting functions if DisplayFusion is installed and running
Change: Type Text action now has an option to control the speed


Updating VoiceBot We encourage everyone to update to this new version today to take advantage of these improvements. If you've already purchased VoiceBot, it's a lifetime license, so you can upgrade to this version at no cost! If you would like to see a complete list of all the changes, please visit the VoiceBot change log. Thank you to everyone who helped to test the beta versions, that feedback is what makes VoiceBot so amazing. We would also like to thank all of the translators who have helped translate VoiceBot to their native languages. Thanks everyone!

notes.title: VoiceBot 3.0 has been Released!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that VoiceBot 3.0 is now available for download! This free update adds new actions, new features, and new settings, as well as bug fixes and general improvements.


VoiceBot 3.0 Highlights

Added the ability to control VoiceBot with a Push to Talk or Push to Ignore HotKey
New actions: Double Click Mouse Button, Open File, and Toggle Key
HotKeys can be assigned to individual macros in a profile
Added support for performing VoiceBot Actions from within Macro Scripts
Added settings to change Text to Speech speed and volume
Added an option to start VoiceBot paused
Added the ability to use command line parameters with Start Program actions
Updated "Run Macro" actions to allow the use of global macros
Increased the speed of Type Text actions


We encourage everyone to update to this new version today to take advantage of these improvements. Your VoiceBot license is a lifetime license, so you can upgrade to this version at no cost!

If you would like to see a complete list of all the changes, please visit the VoiceBot Change Log. We'd like to send out a big thanks to the dozens of people who helped with the DisplayFusion translations, and the thousands of people that helped test the Beta versions. Thanks everyone!

notes.title: VoiceBot 2.0 Now Available!
notes.content:
VoiceBot 2.0 is now available for download! This version adds some excellent new features, and fixes a few bugs as well. Important note for existing VoiceBot customers: With the addition of the Global Macros feature, VoiceBot 1.6 and 2.0 settings are not compatible, so sync has been disabled for version 1.6 and lower.

VoiceBot 2.0 Highlights

Added a new Global Macros tab in the Settings window, these macros will be recognized regardless of which profile is currently active
Added an online repository for downloading pre-made Macro Scripts
Added a global "Stop Macros" command to cancel all currently running macros
Added KeyDown/KeyUp support in Macro Scripts
Added the ability to add more voices for the "Text-to-Speech" action (in different languages too)
Added the ability to specify multiple phrases for a TTS action, it will randomly choose one each time it runs
Added an action that changes the audio output device
Resolved an issue where the volume control actions didn't work
Increased the maximum hold time on the Press and Release Key action to 999 seconds
Various performance, stability, and bug fixes
